titre: Black's queen is attacked. What does Rubinstein play? ♟️ #chess #shorts
description:
Rotlewi – Rubinstein, Lodz 1907 (source: Wikipedia). 22.g3 attacked the queen, and Rubinstein ignored it: 22...Rxc3! 23.gxh4 Rd2!! 24.Qxd2 Bxe4+ 25.Qg2 Rh3 and White resigned, mate is coming. Checked with Stockfish. Would you have given up the queen? 👇
